g.text: Each row is one complete input filter. ADC clamps share the sensor-ground and reference domains; thermistor calibration remains required.

g.text: MS3X AN11 is assigned to MAF; AN12 to the second front oxygen sensor.

g.desc: MS3X AN11 is assigned to MAF; AN12 to the second front oxygen sensor.

g.text: AN13 and AD6 are available at the expansion connector. Firmware MAF pin selection must match AN11.
